title: Cap. VII: Resp. 1 tertium — ἐφ᾽ ᾧ construction overturns the "in quo" version
pass_a_gloss: To those two faults a third is also added: Garissoles contradicts himself. If the Apostle's mind was what this reply attributes to him, then the words ἐφ᾽ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον must be construed after all the antecedents — sin entered the world, and through sin death, and so death pervaded into all — because they would then answer a question that could arise from those immediately preceding words. That overturns the rendering 'in which.' For once that rendering is assumed, the words 'in which all sinned' must be construed before all those antecedents: they cohere at once with the noun ἀνθρώπου, and there is a transposition. So the construction would have to be: As through one man, in whom all sinned, sin entered into the world, and through sin death, and so death pervaded into all men. Locked Greek lemma: ἐφ᾽ ᾧ / ἥμαρτον — do not revive the OCR misread ἔργον.
pass_b_english: To those two vices a third also is added. For he contradicts himself. For if that was the mind of the Apostle which this response attributes to him, certainly the words ἐφ᾽ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον (Romans 5:12) ought to be construed after all the antecedents — "sin entered into the world, and death through sin, and so death pervaded into all" — for they would answer the question that could arise from those immediately preceding words. That overturns the version "in which." For with that version posited, the words "in which all sinned" ought to be construed before all those: for they cohere immediately with the noun ἀνθρώπου, and there is a transposition. So they ought to be construed: "As through one man, in whom all sinned, sin entered into the world, and death through sin, and so death pervaded into all men" (Romans 5:12).
source_text: Ad duo ista vitia accedit etiam tertium. Sibi enim ipse repugnat. Nam si ea fuit mens Apostoli quam ei tribuit haec responsio, certe verba ἐφ᾽ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον construi debent, post antecedentia omnia, peccatum in mundum introiit, et per peccatum mors, et ita mors in omnes pervasit: responsio enim essent ad quaestionem, quae ex verbis illis immediate praecedentibus exoriri poterat. Id quod versionem in quo evertit. Ea enim posita construi debent verba in quo omnes peccaverunt, ante illa omnia: cohaerent enim immediate cum nomine ἀνθρώπου et est trajectio. Sic ergo construi deberent, Sicut per unum hominem, in quo omnes peccaverunt, peccatum in mundum introiit, et per peccatum mors, et ita in omnes homines mors pervasit.
